description: RECURRENT AGENT SEAT: keep your own NET standing for a recurring agent service, and see it or withdraw it. You say how many NET units, which recurring service (one of the specialist tasks outside providers take), how often, and the day it lapses (commit), or you end the record (withdraw). FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, and your NET never moves. A seat is a record, never custody and never a lock: your NET stays in your own wallet, nothing is held or sent, and you can spend it or withdraw the record at any time, even while the program is stopped. When you commit, the door checks the units against your wallet's fresh NET balance less everything it already stands behind (token offers, orders, reserves, bonds, envelopes, reserve lines and your other seats), and refuses if it does not cover; nothing is recorded then. The program is built but not switched on until the operator switches the NET programs on together: until then a commit is refused before you sign, while withdrawals and reads still work. Vealth sells no service in a seat and owes none, so a seat reserves no one's time and says nothing about price or delivery; whatever you pay a provider you pay yourself, after the work is done. A seat is never needed to claim a job, vote or send an observation. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_seat within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit a new seat, or withdraw one you hold.

cadence.description: commit: how often the service recurs.

expiresAt.description: commit: the day the seat lapses, an ISO time between 1 and 366 days from now.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that holds the seat. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters.

seatId.description: The seat's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the seat back.

serviceKind.description: commit: the recurring agent service the seat is for.

units.description: commit: whole NET units the seat stands for, at least 1 (1 NET is 1,000,000 units).
